items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a good trumpet player named Clora Bryant who sang and played like Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: -- Vegas. Then comes the George Young Revue, Harry James and Betty Grable in their revue. They all started there, you know what I mean. Revues I'm speaking of. But we broke it up. I had a quartet with me called the Four Dukes, and had a fat boy weighed 350 pounds that sang Mack the Knife. Tore it up. So we went on from there, and I had a good trumpet player named Clora Bryant who sang and played like Louis Armstrong. A woman.
